diagram_previews.alt: Obtuse isosceles triangle ABC inscribed in a blue circle, with A at the top and the base BC horizontal; arcs mark the 41 degree angles at B and C. The centre O lies just below BC, outside the triangle. Red dashed radii OB and OC form the angle BOC, marked by a small red arc whose label 164 degrees sits above BC, joined to the arc by a short leader line.
